correctness.rationale: For every odd prime p>=5, the polynomial P(X)=sum q_i(2-X^i-X^(p-i)) and cyclotomic minimality imply Q-linear independence of distinct nonzero cycle-Laplacian eigenvalues. PBH plus exact Fourier multiplicity gives lower bounds 4 and 8, while adjacent 2-by-2 and 2-by-4 Fourier/Vandermonde restriction arguments prove attainable rank for all eigenspaces, including index-zero boundary cases. Rational unequal direction ratios give no accidental resonances. The n=6 composite exception and the finite exceptional algebraic locus delineate scope. Independently constructed matrix and modal checks (85) corroborate but are not a substitute for proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives exact optimal coordinate actuator sets for an infinite natural family of weighted periodic diffusion systems. Four versus eight is a structurally sharp symmetry-induced discontinuity, not a routine constant perturbation. The exceptional algebraic-ratio locus and a concrete composite-cycle six-mode obstruction explain where the arithmetic mechanism applies and where it fails. This direct sparse actuation rule can inform network controllability design; no unproved energy or robustness guarantees are claimed.
